title: fix(plugin-auth): the identity import's invitation link lands on the Console set-password page (#23152)
body:
Fixes #23152
Clause-②: yes (widening) — adds the public `AuthManager.getConsoleUrl(path)` and the optional `IdentityImportDeps.consoleResetPasswordUrl()`

Changeset level: `@objectstack/plugin-auth` **minor**, the precedent of #22463 (`e148ca984`), which declared an optional addition to an exported plugin-auth API `Clause-②: yes (widening)` at `minor`. Both new members are re-exported through `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/index.ts` (`export * from './auth-manager.js'` and `export * from './admin-import-users.js'`), and both reach the built `dist/index.d.ts` (one hit each, with `sendPhoneInviteSms(phone: string)` as the positive control).

This follows triage's direction `6140964843`: the import's reset request carries a `redirectTo` to the Console's set-password page, built from the same source the Console's own links use. The deps member is optional, and the new `AuthManager` member is a public console-page URL reader.

## What changed

- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts`: a new public `getConsoleUrl(path)`. Its body is one line, `return this.getConsolePageUrl(path);`. The private composer that builds every Console link this class sends (`origin` + `uiBasePath` + `path`) is unchanged, and no second URL builder exists.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-import-users.ts`:
  - `IdentityImportDeps` gains the optional `consoleResetPasswordUrl?(): string`.
  - When it is present, the email invitation requests `{ email, redirectTo: deps.consoleResetPasswordUrl() }`.
  - When it is absent, the request is `{ email }`, byte for byte as today. The import already uses this shape for its other optional members (`getMetaItem`, `getSchema`).
  - A throw from the member lands in the existing per-row `catch`, as `INVITE_EMAIL_FAILED`.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-plugin.ts`: one wiring line in the import mount's deps object, beside its SMS twin `sendInviteSms`. It reads `consoleResetPasswordUrl: () => this.authManager!.getConsoleUrl('/reset-password')`.
- The page is the one the Console serves. At the objectui pin `1fb1ced36243` (`.objectui-sha`, unchanged), `apps/console/src/App.tsx:208` routes `/reset-password` under the SPA basename to `ResetPasswordPage`, which reads `?token=`. The Console's own forgot-password flow passes `BASENAME/reset-password` as its `redirectTo` (`packages/auth/src/createAuthClient.ts`).

## Measured first (dispatch Zone 2)

1. **The defect still reproduces on `main`** (`cc14657ed`). `admin-import-users.ts:704` called `requestPasswordReset({ body: { email } })` with no `redirectTo`. better-auth 1.7.3 then builds `…/reset-password/TOKEN?callbackURL=` (`dist/api/routes/password.mjs:80-81`), and its GET handler redirects to the error page on `!callbackURL` (`:124`). I measured it end to end through the real mount (leg A below): with the three source files restored to `cc14657ed`, the emailed link's GET answered `Received: "https://acme.example.com/api/v1/auth/error?error=INVALID_TOKEN"`. I wrote no separate probe. The ablated tree was the probe, and it was restored to `HEAD` (blob hashes equal, `git diff HEAD` empty).
2. **The SMS twin is the house shape.** It holds. `sendInviteSms: (phone) => this.authManager!.sendPhoneInviteSms(phone)` sits in the same deps object, and `sendPhoneInviteSms` composes its link through `getConsolePageUrl('/login')`. The optional member plus the reader needed exactly one wiring line.
3. **The origin check.** It holds, with the check ON. Under a test runner better-auth defaults `skipOriginCheck` to `isTest()` (`dist/context/create-context.mjs:211`). The pin turns it off on the resolved context, which the handler copies per request. With the check on, the redirect to `https://acme.example.com/_console/reset-password?token=…` is accepted, because `baseURL`'s origin is trusted, and a foreign `callbackURL` on the same token is refused with `403`. Leg E shows that without the flip the foreign one is redirected (`302`).
4. **Exports and level.** It holds, as above. #22800's changeset (`f9ebb7dd3`) relied on `IdentityImportDeps` keeping its shape, and this PR changes that shape additively.

## Pins

`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-import-users-invite-link.test.ts` runs a real ObjectQL over driver-sql (better-sqlite3 in memory), this plugin's manifest objects, a real `AuthManager` (admin plugin on, `baseUrl` `https://acme.example.com`) with a capturing email service, and better-auth's origin check on.

- **①** It drives the plugin's REAL `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/import-users` mount, through `registerAuthRoutes` on Hono, so the wiring line is under test. That matters because the member is optional, so a missing line still compiles. The emailed `auth.password_reset` link's GET answers `302` to `https://acme.example.com/_console/reset-password?token=TOKEN`. A control with a foreign `callbackURL` is refused with `403` and no `location`. `POST /reset-password` with that token answers `200`. Only the platform-admin gate's session read is a stand-in, the `principal-less-producers-system-context.test.ts` shape. Every other manager call reaches the real manager through a `Proxy`.
- **②** It calls `runAdminImportUsers` with deps that carry no `consoleResetPasswordUrl`. The link stays today's link, `…/reset-password/TOKEN?callbackURL=`.
- `admin-import-users.test.ts` gains two unit cases that pin the request body strictly in both directions (`toStrictEqual` on `mock.lastCall`). With the member the body is `{ email, redirectTo }`. Without it the body is `{ email }`, with no `redirectTo` key at all.

## Reverse verification (one-shot; no permanent test files)

Each leg was mutated on disk with its marker counts read back, run, and restored to `HEAD`, proven by blob hash equal to `HEAD` and an empty `git diff HEAD`. Legs B to E used `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` and leg A used a trap-armed script. Every subject here resolves from `src/` through relative imports, so no leg needed a rebuild. The test runs were `vitest run --reporter=verbose` on the two files, under the verify lock.

| leg | mutation | expected | observed |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | all three source files at `cc14657ed` (today's `main`) | ① red, ② green | ① red, `Received: "https://acme.example.com/api/v1/auth/error?error=INVALID_TOKEN"`; ② green |
| B | the `auth-plugin.ts` wiring line deleted | only ① red | `Tests 1 failed / 39 passed (40)`: ① red with the same `INVALID_TOKEN` landing |
| C | the import sends `{ email }` even when the member is present | ① red and the "names the page" unit case red | `2 failed / 38 passed (40)`, exactly those two |
| D | the absent branch sends a `redirectTo` anyway | ② red and the "exactly { email }" unit case red | `2 failed / 38 passed (40)`, exactly those two; ② `Received: …?callbackURL=https%3A%2F%2Facme.example.com%2F_console%2Freset-password` |
| E | the pin's `skipOriginCheck = false` deleted | ① red at the foreign-origin control | ① red, `expected 302 to be 403` |

## Tests

Every reading below was taken at the final commit `825365af7` (`git rev-parse --short HEAD`), each under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, on a shared box.

- **Builds.**
  - `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/plugin-auth^...' build` (dependency closure, 29 projects): `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
  - Then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth run build`: `VERDICT command-exit 0`, with `check-dts-emitted: @objectstack/plugin-auth - 2/2 declared declaration file(s) present`.
- **Typecheck.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth run typecheck` (the `src` program, the examples program, then `check:test-typecheck`): `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
  - The ratchet reads `check:test-typecheck: OK … 10 file(s) / 94 error(s) / 23 pinned signature(s) held in test-typecheck-debt.json`, which is the ledger unchanged.
  - The new test file is in that program: `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists it (1 hit), among 139 test files.
- **Tests.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth run test`: `Test Files  139 passed (139)` and `Tests  2798 passed | 10 skipped (2808)`. Before this PR the package had 138 test files.
- **Gates.**
  - `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, with no paths, derived 68 commands. All 68 were run, each exit code recorded before any pipe.
  - Reconciled with `--ran`: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 68 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 67 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)`. The 67 that ran exited 0.
  - **NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`.** Reason: `PREREQUISITE NOT MET — this gate reads built output, and some package has no dist/`. It needs the whole tree built, and 39 packages outside this diff's closure had no `dist/` in this worktree. CI builds the tree.
- **Lint (a measured narrowing; the whole-tree `pnpm lint` is CI's run).**
  - `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` on the 5 changed TypeScript files: `files 5 errors 0 warnings 0`.
  - The population was read from eslint's own API: `isPathIgnored` is false for all 5.
  - Invariance: no file's computed config enables type-aware parsing (`parserOptions.project` / `projectService` are absent), so this diff cannot move the verdict of any file it does not touch.
- **Reverse verification.** See the table above. Legs A to E ran at the same `HEAD`, each restored and proven.

## Acceptance notes

- **Two notes for reviewers.**
  - The changeset names `runAdminImportUsers` hosts that build their own deps. Such a host keeps today's dead link until it wires `consoleResetPasswordUrl`. This is the cost of the optional member that triage ruled. In this repo the only builder of these deps is `auth-plugin.ts`.
  - The doc page `content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx` (Bulk Import Users) already says "a real email gets a set-your-password email". This PR makes that sentence true and does not edit the page, which is outside the claimed file surface.
- **The invitation copy, out of scope here.** The invitation still renders the password-reset template (`auth.password_reset`), whose copy says "If you didn't request this, ignore this email" to a user who requested nothing. The copy lives at `packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/templates/auth-templates.ts:78` and `:87`, and pin ① finds the invitation by that template key. The card names this as its secondary note, outside triage's direction. A distinct template key is new surface, so it is reported to the seat as a finding and not changed here.
- **`origin/main` moved during this run.** It went to `ca0bdbcca`, with two commits in `spec`, `service-automation` and `metadata-protocol`, none in `plugin-auth` or its tests. I did not merge. CI runs on the merge ref.
